---
title: About writing data
description: Insert, update, upsert, and delete data in your database using SQL
products: [cloud, mst, self_hosted]
---

import * as C from "@constants";
import { Callout } from "@stainless-api/docs/components";

The write path stays familiar: {C.TIMESCALE_DB} accepts the same `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, and `DELETE` statements as regular
{C.POSTGRESQL} for both plain tables and {C.HYPERTABLE}s.

To find out how to add and sync data to your {C.SERVICE_SHORT} from other sources, see
[Migrate](/migrate).

<Callout variant="note">
{C.TIMESCALE_DB} is optimized for running real-time analytics workloads on time-series data. For this reason, {C.HYPERTABLE}s are optimized for
inserts to the most recent time intervals. Inserting data with recent time
values gives
[excellent performance](https://www.tigerdata.com/blog/postgresql-timescaledb-1000x-faster-queries-90-data-compression-and-much-more).
However, if you need to make frequent updates to older time intervals, you
might see lower write throughput.
</Callout>
